parameter.units_comment: space delimited ISO 8601 format up to seconds

parameter.comment: Date of final instant. Two years.
Base Date for time stamping purposes. Optional, default = 1950/1/1
Computation threads for shared memory computation (default=auto)

BathyminNetcdf.comment: bathymetry is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (computes from layer depth and openPoints. Default = 1

RugosityinNetcdf.comment: Rugosity of the seabed is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (Default = 0, read from constant input value)

D50inNetcdf.comment: D50 (median diameter) of the seabed is a property in the netcdf. 1:true, 0:false (Default = 0, read from constant input value)

resolution.units_comment: metres (m). 100 m fills this polygon with 561 points in one vertical layer.

rate_seconds.comment: With dt=60 and active 0-120 s the initial emission stack fires once and does not refill.

rate_trcPerEmission.comment: number of tracers emiited every rate_seconds. 5 is a 5 tracers per rate_seconds

active.comment: Two timesteps. Combined with rate_seconds=120 this is one instantaneous release.

type.comment: sphere, radius 0.5 mm, density 950 kg m-3

DiffusionCoeffVert.comment: Vertical diffusion coefficient; used directly. Default = 0.000001.

Rugosity.comment: Rugosity / bed roughness length eps0. Default = 0.0025

D50.comment: D50 (Median diameter of seabed) value. Default = 0.0025

D50Density.comment: D50 density (Median diameter of seabed density) value. Default = 2500.0

BeachingLevel.comment: Level above which beaching can occur. Default = -3.0

BeachingStopProb.comment: Probablity of beaching stopping a tracer. Default = 50%

StokesDriftCoeff.comment: Stokes drift omitted. No wave files are read.

ResuspensionProb.comment: On in every case. Only tracers that reach the bed can be resuspended.

ResuspensionCriticalShear1.comment: Unused with method 2; tau_cr comes from Shields/Soulsby.

ResuspensionCriticalShear2.comment: Unused with method 2; tau_cr comes from Shields/Soulsby.

ToptBMin.comment: minimum temperature of the optimal interval for the Bacteria growth. Default = 24.8

ToptBMax.comment: maximum temperature of the optimal interval for the Bacteria growth. Default = 25.1

TBMin.comment: minimum tolerable temperature of the interval for the Bacteria growth. Default = 5

TBMax.comment: maximum tolerable temperature of the interval for the Bacteria growth. Default = 35

BK1.comment: constant to control temperature response curve shape. Default = 0.05

BK2.comment: constant to control temperature response curve shape. Default = 0.98

BK3.comment: constant to control temperature response curve shape. Default = 0.98

BK4.comment: constant to control temperature response curve shape. Default = 0.05
